mentions.name: Skuilder (vue-skuilder)
mentions.description: An open-source framework for building general purpose interactive tutoring systems, built on Vue. It combines a spaced-repetition (SRS) background process with a pluggable system of pedagogy protocols applied over a given curriculum.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a framework for general purpose interactive tutoring systems. An SRS background process over a pluggable system of pedagogy protocols over a given curriculum.

evidence.value: I'm working on a framework for general purpose interactive tutoring systems. An SRS background process over a pluggable system of pedagogy protocols over a given curriculum.
evidence.author: NiloCK

mentions.name: Skuilder
mentions.description: An open-source (AGPL) stack for building interactive tutoring systems. It provides SRS++ with hooks for defining custom pedagogical protocols over knowledge dependency graphs, Elo rating systems, and a gracefully differentiable curriculum that can hill-climb in efficacy. The author is scaffolding commercial learning SaaS products on top of it.
mentions.audience: Developers building interactive tutoring and learning systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on [1] a modernized open (AGPL) stack for interactive tutoring systems. SRS++, with hooks for defining your own pedagogical protocols over knowledge dependency graphs, Elo rating systems, etc, and with an eye toward gracefully differentiable curriculum that can hill-climb in terms of its efficacy.

evidence.value: I am working on [1] a modernized open (AGPL) stack for interactive tutoring systems. SRS++, with hooks for defining your own pedagogical protocols over knowledge dependency graphs, Elo rating systems, etc, and with an eye toward gracefully differentiable curriculum that can hill-climb in terms of its efficacy.
